title: Shuttle: Dependency-Attributed Workflow Evolution for Smart Contract Auditing
abstract: arXiv:2611.31929v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In LLM-based smart contract auditing, detection quality depends on both model capability and workflow design. While coding agents can revise workflows from execution feedback, unconstrained rewrites rarely yield stable gains. Cross-function vulnerabilities require multi-step state tracking and boundary reasoning that coarse pipelines miss. End-to-end outcomes hide which step lost a clue, so direct rewrites regress existing hits or discard valid edits under coarse aggregate scoring. Repeatedly iterating on a small project set also adds case-specific heuristics that bloat prompts and hurt generalization. We present Shuttle, a constrained workflow-evolution system, and LucidScan, the auditing framework it evolves. Shuttle centers on provenance-graph attribution: it expands each run into an instance-level dependency graph, locates the node where a clue was lost via forward search, and traces existing hits backward into a protected set. translated_title: Shuttle：面向智能合约审计的依赖归因工作流演化
translated_abstract: 在基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能合约审计中，检测质量既取决于模型能力，也取决于工作流设计。虽然编程智能体可以根据执行反馈修改工作流，但不受约束的改写很少带来稳定收益。跨函数漏洞需要多步状态跟踪和边界推理，而粗糙的流水线往往难以捕捉。端到端的结果掩盖了哪个步骤丢失了线索，因此在粗糙的聚合评分下，直接的改写会导致已有检测成果的退化，或丢弃有效的编辑。此外，在小规模项目集上反复迭代还会引入针对特定案例的启发式规则，使提示词膨胀并损害泛化能力。我们提出了Shuttle——一个受约束的工作流演化系统，以及由它演化的审计框架LucidScan。Shuttle的核心是溯源图归因：它将每次运行展开为实例级依赖图，通过前向搜索定位线索丢失的节点，并将已有的检测成果向后追溯为受保护集合。
tldr: Shuttle通过溯源图归因定位工作流中线索丢失的环节并保护已有检测成果，实现受约束的智能合约审计工作流演化，避免了无约束改写导致的性能退化和泛化能力下降。
en_tdlr: Shuttle enables constrained workflow evolution for smart contract auditing through provenance-graph attribution that localizes lost clues and protects existing hits, avoiding regressions and overfitting caused by unconstrained rewrites.
